lines.text: One million names, sorted. Find one.
Check them in order, and you might need one million checks.
Instead, open the middle. Is the name before it or after it? Throw away half.
Open the middle of what is left. Throw away half again.
Each check halves the list. One million. Five hundred thousand. Two hundred fifty thousand.
Twenty checks is enough, because two to the power of twenty is just over a million.
Double the list to two million, and you need just one more check.
The work grows slowly, while the list grows fast.
